question: How often do I see Dr. Johnson?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I've been having trouble falling asleep some nights despite trying journaling and a consistent sleep schedule. Can you suggest some additional strategies to help me improve my sleep quality?

[turn 2] I've been trying to prioritize self-care activities like yoga and meditation, and it's been helping with my anxiety levels. Do you think these activities can also help with sleep quality? And by the way, I have a therapy session with Dr. Smith coming up soon - it's every two weeks, so I'm looking forward to discussing my progress with her.

[turn 4] I've been feeling overwhelmed with commitments lately, and Dr. Smith suggested I learn to say "no" and set healthy boundaries. Do you have any tips on how to do this without feeling guilty or anxious?

[turn 6] I've been thinking about setting boundaries with my partner, especially when it comes to social commitments. They tend to invite me to a lot of events, but sometimes I just want to stay home and relax. Do you think it's okay to set boundaries with your partner, and if so, how do I bring it up with them?

[turn 8] I think I'm ready to have this conversation with my partner. I'll try to approach it calmly and use "I" statements to express my feelings. Do you have any tips on how to handle potential pushback or resistance from my partner?

[turn 10] I think I'm ready to have this conversation with my partner. I'll try to stay calm and use "I" statements to express my feelings. I'll also anticipate their concerns and respond thoughtfully. Thanks for the tips!

[turn 0] I'm feeling overwhelmed with work and social commitments. Can you help me organize my schedule and prioritize tasks? By the way, I had a session with Dr. Smith this week and we discussed how I need to set healthy boundaries.

[turn 2] My work hours are 9 to 5, Monday to Friday, and I have a few regular social commitments like weekly yoga class and bi-weekly dinner with friends. I also need to fit in time for self-care activities like meditation and journaling. My top priority right now is to manage my workload and meet deadlines without burning out. I've been struggling to say no to requests from colleagues and friends, which is why setting healthy boundaries is a big focus for me.

[turn 4] I see what you're doing here, but I think it's a bit too structured for me. I'd rather have some flexibility in my schedule. Can you help me come up with a more general plan to prioritize my tasks and set boundaries, rather than a strict schedule? And by the way, speaking of boundaries, I see Dr. Smith every week, and she's been helping me work on this stuff.

[turn 6] This sounds more like what I need. I think I need to work on prioritizing my tasks better and saying no to non-essential commitments. I also want to make sure I have time for self-care activities like meditation and journaling. Can you help me come up with a simple checklist to remind me of my priorities and boundaries?

[turn 8] This looks great! I think this checklist will really help me stay on track and prioritize my tasks and self-care activities. I especially like the reminder to review my priorities and commitments on a weekly basis. Thanks for your help!

[turn 10] I think that's all for now. I'm going to go meditate and journal for a bit. It's been a helpful session with Dr. Smith this week, and I'm feeling more confident about setting those healthy boundaries. Thanks again for your help!
